# Capstone results (generated by work/notebooks/capstone.ipynb)

## Abstract

Which of a client's pages are about to lose search visibility, and can we rank them before it happens? Using an anonymized slice of 30,000 pages from 32 clients, we predicted whether a page's impressions would fall 20% or more in the next 30 days using only information available before that window. A logistic regression was compared against a transparent 0-4 point rule on 5 client-grouped folds, after showing that the 90 day totals the starter pipeline relies on overlap the label window (adding one of them lifts AUC from 0.69 to 0.89 without any real skill). The model's top 50 picks per fold declined 79% of the time (+-12%) versus 69% for the rule and a 54% base rate, and inside a client its top 10 averaged 75% versus a 53% client base rate. The output is a per-client review queue with reason codes, meant as decision-support for where editors look first, not as a forecast of rankings or evidence that refreshing works.

## Results, 5-fold grouped by client (mean +- std)

| method | P@20 | P@50 | P@200 | AUC | base rate |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| logistic regression | 0.820 +- 0.115 | 0.792 +- 0.125 | 0.793 +- 0.094 | 0.695 +- 0.077 | 0.544 |
| my rule baseline | 0.700 +- 0.127 | 0.692 +- 0.131 | 0.693 +- 0.162 | 0.670 +- 0.099 | 0.544 |
| reference starter baseline | 0.420 +- 0.115 | 0.464 +- 0.173 | 0.497 +- 0.169 | 0.599 +- 0.107 | 0.544 |

## Leakage checks (AUC / P@50, 5-fold grouped)

| feature set | AUC | P@50 |
|---|---:|---:|
| final features (honest) | 0.695 | 0.792 |
| + trend_pct (planted leak, harness check) | 0.999 | 1.000 |
| + raw impressions_90d (window arithmetic leak) | 0.892 | 0.992 |
| + 90d ctr, avg_position, days_with_impressions (overlap) | 0.751 | 0.892 |
| shuffled training labels (control, mean of 5) | 0.495 | 0.464 |

## Confidence bands (hindsight, out-of-fold)

| band | declined | pages |
|---|---:|---:|
| high | 0.759 | 1,220 |
| medium | 0.698 | 11,703 |
| low | 0.532 | 10,667 |
| none | 0.233 | 6,410 |

Random 80/20 row split for comparison: AUC 0.737, P@50 0.88.
Within-client top 10 (24 clients with 50+ pages): model 0.75, rule 0.65, client base rate 0.53.
Seeds: 42. pandas 2.2.3, numpy 2.1.3, scikit-learn 1.6.1.
